name: Time to Learn
source:
Hi, new student! First day! Complete your tasks and earn gold stars.

Don’t get on the teacher’s bad side. You’ll do fine. Enjoy school!

[From [url=https://sielle-creature.itch.io/time-to-learn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
嗨，新同学！今天是开学第一天哦！完成你的各项作业，赢取小金星吧。

千万别惹老师不高兴。你会表现得很棒的，祝你校园生活愉快！

[摘自[url=https://sielle-creature.itch.io/time-to-learn]itch.io[/url]]
